evidence.title: Launching Miso One: The Most Emotive AI Voice Model
evidence.publisher: Launching Miso One: The Most Emotive AI Voice Model
evidence.excerpt: Today, we’re excited to introduce Miso One, the most emotive voice model in the world. Miso One is an 8-billion-parameter text-to-speech model for highly expressive speech generation. It emotes like a human and responds faster than a human, with just 110 milliseconds of latency. We’ve open-sourced the model weights, with API access coming soon. To download the model, check out our repo on Github: MisoLabsAI/MisoTTS You can also test out the model directly at misolabs.ai.
